didKey.description: An Ed25519 did:key in canonical multibase base58btc. The pattern checks the alphabet, not the multicodec prefix or the key length -- a verifier checks those.

eventId.description: A LineageAuth event id: sha256 over the signing preimage.

instant.description: RFC3339 UTC, e.g. 2026-08-27T12:00:00Z. Self-asserted by the signer.

description: The common shape of a `root.create` payload (authority family). Type-specific fields are intentionally not constrained here: they are validated by the reader for that type, which can express rules a schema cannot -- that a receipt is signed by the worker it names, that a threshold is a strict majority of the seats. This schema describes shape only. A document that validates against it may still carry an invalid signature, a signer with no authority, an event id that does not match its payload, or a broken chain above it -- none of which a JSON Schema can express. Validation here is not verification; run a LineageAuth verifier.

issuedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC, e.g. 2026-08-27T12:00:00Z. Self-asserted by the signer.
